curation_rules: Official SMR Monasteroris separately notes friary and two castles in 1550: keep possible site identity distinction.
Scots 1523 Jedburgh abbey not confirmed burned; primary Surrey says abbey not taken.
Cessford: siege evidence; Ferniehirst: short physical capture/destruction; no Scottish county transfer.
Church deanery of Guînes and 1907 parish list does not prove 1529 Crown English farms.
No coordinate for historic Grummitt Newembridge until independent place identity resolved.
